title: Google Ends Non-Disparagement Requirements for Departing AI Researchers

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Google has stopped requiring that departing employees abide by non-disparagement agreements and has eliminated post-termination restrictions for new hires. A company spokesperson said Tuesday that Google does not enforce these clauses once workers leave the firm and maintains internal channels for employees to escalate concerns to executives.

The change follows a push from researchers at the UK-based Google DeepMind who argued that lifelong gag clauses prevented them from alerting the public to safety risks associated with artificial intelligence. One worker claimed that internal disclosures filed in September regarding the clauses went ignored, asserting that the policy reversal only occurred after the issue gained public and employee awareness.

The company does not enforce non-disparagement clauses after people leave Google, and it has dedicated, internal channels for workers to escalate concerns to top leaders, the spokesperson said.
